name: Earshot
scope: Evaluate voice and radio-speaker audibility, masking and obstruction as bounded perceived sound evidence. Implement ACRE support as well as TFAR through optional provider adapters into existing CBE hearing/investigation owners. No target reveal or independent movement controller.

userConditions.requirement: ACRE must work; existing TFAR-only source description does not satisfy this.

mod.cpp.name: Earshot
mod.cpp.author: Dusky
mod.cpp.overview: AI can hear players talking over Task Force Arrowhead Radio. How far depends on your TFAR voice volume - whisper, normal or yell - and walls, objects and hills muffle you. A squad hears as one, sends soldiers to investigate, and gunfire, explosions, engines, rain and wind cover you. Radios left on speakers give you away too. Needs CBA_A3 and TFAR

identityEvidence: User URL and Workshop page inaccessible through browser tool; installed metadata/package hashes only. No extracted-code review or behaviour proof.
evaluationTopics: Trace actual config/FSM/scripts, callers and native writers; compare selected useful intent with current CBE owners before integration.
Record retained/adapted/rejected methods and dependencies/licence/provenance. No implementation credit from title, metadata or file counts.
Preserve mission/Zeus authority, finite owner-local lifecycle, player/specialist ownership and credible animation; avoid extra permanent scanners/controllers.
dependencies: Local overview names CBA_A3 and TFAR. ACRE support is an additional user requirement, not verified source functionality.
licence: UNVERIFIED; establish original upstream and component-specific reuse rights before incorporating code.
sourceReview: NOT_STARTED; webpage/local metadata and package inventory only.
ordering: Foundations/FSM first, individual behaviour before squad/combined arms; compatibility expansion last. Reference-only items supply methods rather than an automatic implementation obligation.
